title: Background Task Supervisor
instructions: Implement `TaskSupervisor` in `supervisor.py`. It keeps strong references to fire-and-forget tasks, reports a failed task to `on_error(name, exc)` exactly once, and never reports a cancelled one. `shutdown(grace)` rejects new work, drains running tasks for up to `grace` seconds, cancels the rest, waits for their cleanup and returns how many it cancelled.

evidence.label: Reports a failed task to on_error with its name and exception
Calls on_error exactly once per failed task
Returns a named Task; pending counts unfinished tasks and drops finished ones
Keeps a strong reference so an unreferenced task is not garbage collected
Drains fast tasks, cancels slow ones, runs their cleanup and does not report cancellation as an error
Raises RuntimeError after shutdown and closes the rejected coroutine
Returns 0 when shutdown is called a second time
Returns 0 when there is nothing to shut down
